rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something located on the lower floor.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 lau4 haa6 dang2 nei5

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken expression for going down the stairs or to the lower floor.

example.english: I'm going downstairs now to get something.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 lok6 lau4 haa6 ling1 je5
